name: Lobster Salad
description: Historical recipe from The Canadian Family Cook Book (1914). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Break the leaves from a head of lettuce, let stand in a pan of ice cold water till crisp
Lay the leaves on a board and shave fine
Just before serving mix the lettuce, lobster and half a cup of dressing together lightly with a fork
Arrange some lettuce leaves on a dish and put the mixture in the centre

source.author: Grace E. Denison
source.originalInstructions:
1. Cut lobster quite fine (not chop)
2. Break the leaves from a head of lettuce, let stand in a pan of ice cold water till crisp
3. Lay the leaves on a board and shave fine
4. Just before serving mix the lettuce, lobster and half a cup of dressing together lightly with a fork
5. Arrange some lettuce leaves on a dish and put the mixture in the centre
